messages.subject: Estimation of multiple RW1 spline models/ cmin
parts:
Hello,

I'm encountering pardiso errors when trying to fit a model with multiple spline / nonlinear effects using a RW1 model.

Is it possible I don't have enough fixed effects in my model? Or might this be a prior issue?

I was curious what kind of results I would get changing some fixed effects I believe could be nonlinear to be estimated by the RW1 model.

My setup is to create 100 quantile groups of several variables, and then try to fit an rw1 model on each. 

These are the errors:

*** PARDISO ERROR(0): not pos.def matrix: 1 eigenvalues are negative.
*** PARDISO ERROR: I will try to work around the problem...

*** PARDISO ERROR(0): not pos.def matrix: 2 eigenvalues are negative.
*** PARDISO ERROR: I will try to work around the problem...

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Estimation of multiple RW1 spline models/ cmin
parts:
this is almost always a numerical stability issue that the 'constr=T' is
fixing, but one need the model to be proper (numerically) also without
it, so...

its often an easy fix, either to set, especially, a ``more proper''
prior for the intercept, or if you have many 'rw's then there could also
be an confounding issue among those (then f(.., model="rw1",
diagonal=...)', is what to adjust. just make sure you use
scale.model=T
